note: Alfalfa County OK (40003): searched ArcGIS (state and county boxes) and the web. The county site's maps page lists commissioner, school and town maps (Amorita, Burlington, Byron, Carmen, Driftwood, Goltry, Cherokee additions) but no zoning layer or service. No zoning ordinance is posted online, and no ArcGIS zoning service exists for the county or its towns (Cherokee, Carmen, Burlington, Goltry). Oklahoma counties zone only unincorporated land by commission action under 19-868.11, and no such map is published.
